prompt: What is the Solr-built-in tagger request handler's class name (the one available since Solr 7.4)? Just the class.
The built-in TaggerRequestHandler uses a Lucene data structure for fast lookup. What's it called (the acronym is fine)?
notes: Finite State Transducer (FST) — low memory, fast lookup; postingsFormat='FST50'

prompt: The built-in tagger has an `overlaps` parameter. Name three valid values for it.
notes: ALL (keep all overlapping), NO_SUB (drop subsumed), LONGEST_DOMINANT_RIGHT (greedy left-to-right)

prompt: Name three hard limitations of solr.TaggerRequestHandler that often push teams to a custom handler in semantic search systems.
notes: No fuzzy, no prefix, no per-match-type scoring, single-shard requirement, no native graph output, no multi-language analyzer per request

prompt: When using solr.TaggerRequestHandler in SolrCloud, is there a constraint on the dictionary collection's sharding?
notes: Concept/dictionary collection must be single-sharded; the tagger doesn't yet support a sharded index

prompt: What postingsFormat must I set on the tag field for solr.TaggerRequestHandler to work, and what global codec factory is required in solrconfig.xml? Two answers, brief.
notes: postingsFormat='FST50' on the tag field; codecFactory class='solr.SchemaCodecFactory' globally

prompt: For multi-word entities like 'New York City' to tag correctly with solr.TaggerRequestHandler, which Lucene filter must appear in the INDEX-time analyzer of the tag field?
notes: ConcatenateGraphFilterFactory at index time concatenates multi-token entries into single FST entries

prompt: Describe a pragmatic hybrid pattern: using solr.TaggerRequestHandler for the dictionary lookup but a thin custom layer for additional logic. One short sentence.
notes: Custom orchestrator handles synonyms/multi-language/graph but delegates the FST lookup to built-in tagger via internal request

prompt: When is solr.TaggerRequestHandler sufficient on its own (no custom handler needed)? Two short examples.
notes: Autocomplete suggestions; one-shot query-understanding (which brand was mentioned?); exact-match-only domains
